4072.d: If memory serves the Legion of Chaos was way harder to defeat in the past...

4073.d: It's as if…our enemy has totally changed since the last volcanic eruption.

4074.d: ...That eruption was certainly big but how is it related to a change in the Chaos Creatures?

4076.d: Valeera…thinking about this will not help in battle. We'd better hold that thought until the war is over.

4077.d: Well... I agree. Let's discuss something else Ithil. Can you tell me what you plan to do after the war is over?

4078.d: ...I actually haven't thought of this in detail.

4079.d: Well just let me know what you're thinking when you start to think of it!

4080.d: Haha sure...Maybe I will go on a journey.

4082.d: That's right. I've spent almost my entire life on the battlefield so I'd like to see the world when it's at peace.

4083.d: Maybe a hidden place silent enough to let me have a full night's sleep.

4084.d: Huh doesn't really seem like you.

4086.d: Me? I want to build a library with countless books and make it my home.

4087.d: I can read myself to sleep and continue reading when I wake up. For me that's paradise! Maybe you should join me since libraries are also silent places.

4088.d: I don't know. Libraries are difficult to keep clean.

4090.d: But maybe after the war I will be able to refine my spell and successfully dull your senses. Then you'll be free from doing housework for therapy!

4093.d: ... I think it's time for us to head out.

4094.d: If I remember correctly our orders were to group up with Esau and Jacob.

4095.d: That's right so let's not keep the twins waiting.

4096.d: This is harder than I thought.

4097.d: I think this is why the mission requires a four Valkyrie squad.

4098.d: I didn't realize there was a Chaos Creature hideout here...

4099.d: But it should be the only one in this area. If we take it out the area will be secured.

4100.d: True but just in case I will scout the terrain. You can follow me and cover my six.

4101.d: Alright leave the job to us!

4104.d: (All my sense are telling me that Chaos Creatures are nearby…but the further I'm from my teammates the fainter this feeling gets.)

4107.d: (Better take care of this one first.)

4108.d: Done. Looks like there's one hideout here. The threat has been eliminated.

4109.d: Leave the rest to the combat unit.

4110.d: You should be the captain of Scout Unit Ithil...

4111.d: But I thought Scout Unit doesn't have such experienced fighters...

4112.d: That's not true. We also operate surgical strikes. You know we are the only ones capable enough to infiltrate enemy territory.

4114.d: I knew this would be an easy job. Now let's head back to base! I've got many books to read.

4116.d: (Was that Esau or Jacob? Both of them...?)

4118.d: Jacob could you please come with me?

4121.d: (I was right…the presence of Chaos comes from Jacob)

4122.d: Be straight with me. Who are you…or what's hiding inside you?

4124.d: I knew this couldn't be hidden from you during this mission.

4125.d: There's something evil locked inside my body and it drove me to do something horrible...

4126.d: But thanks to my sister it no longer has that kind of influence on me.

4127.d: Is that so? It still seems very risky to me. I say we better take that evil out once and for all.

4128.d: Ithil... killing me is not a valid option. I once tried to bring it down with me but I'm not sure if it will help.

4129.d: Just think of it. We've taken the advantage because of the leader of Chaos is absent.

4130.d: If we release it once more it will recover its command of the Legion of Chaos...

4132.d: But if we keep it inside me the risk is lower. My sister and I will be the last line of defense.

4133.d: The war is almost over so please...

4137.d: Let's talk about this after the war is over.

4139.d: Now let's return before they start to worry.

4142.d: (What if something happens and she loses control...)

4143.d: 98th Year of the Chaos Calendar. The war has almost been won.

4144.d: The moon sat bright in the sky casting its light across the land.

4145.d: It was if it was saying that the end was close.

4146.d: Move up! We take that field we end this war once and for all!

4149.d: It would be stupid to be killed by the last bullet of the war...

4153.d: The war has come to an end.

4154.d: It was our honor to fight alongside you Captain…

4157.d: There will be no more fighting in the future so my rank has no use.

4159.d: Just call me by my name.

4161.d: You shouldn't be so serious all the time. Now let's return home.

4162.d: Then…to a silent place to rest---

4163.d: Report! The base is under attack by a giant Chaos force!

4166.d: Everyone who's still able to fight pull back at once!

4167.d: How can there be so many enemies?

4168.d: The base…the ones inside might have already...

4169.d: It's no use dwelling on that! We need to return immediately!

4170.d: Damn...I used too much energy in the last battle and the enemies on our tail are getting close...

4171.d: ...Captain Ithil just head out. I'll take care of any pursuing enemies.

4174.d: I still remember what they taught us. We are all dim lights…and it will take more than us to build up a new era.

4175.d: Captain Ithil...I've followed you up to this point. I don't regret my choice.

4177.d: Like I said before I'm stronger than you are...I'm staying with you.

4179.d: Ithil continue on your path. We won't let you down.

4182.d: Wait... Did you call her by her name?

4183.d: I did. Captain allowed me to do so.

4185.d: Maybe you should try it next time.

4190.d: …Has all our effort been in vain?

4191.d: How could it go so wrong...?

4192.d: Do you know of this valley?

4193.d: It used to be known as the Monument of Boundaries.

4194.d: Is this because I ignored the information given by Kratos?

4197.d: Is that because I didn't pay attention to Turin's warning?

4198.d: But if we keep it inside me the risk is lower. My sister and I will be the last line of defense.

4199.d: The war is almost over so please...

4200.d: Is this because I showed sympathy to Jacob?

4202.d: We did nothing wrong…and yet why are we suffering?

4205.d: Calm down. I am your creator the order of this world. You may call me "Li".

4206.d: So you are the one who created this tragedy.

4207.d: I cannot deny that but all this is necessary for the greater good. You should understand this.

4209.d: Sure Yume has been seriously damaged but there is still a chance to rebuild...

4210.d: But the ones who have already died...

4211.d: I cannot bring them back. Even if I could reform their bodies they would contain different souls.

4212.d: I see. I can't believe you can do any good.

4213.d: Ithil you will assist the new Observer to rebuild Yume and become its new leader to prepare for future dangers.

4214.d: You seem confident that I will take your offer.

4215.d: I find no reason for you to refuse.

4217.d: I still remember what they taught us. We are all dim lights…and it will take more than us to build up a new era.

4218.d: Captain Ithil...I've followed you up to this point. I don't regret my choice.

4220.d: Of course I won't. But a warning to you: I'm not the kind of person who will be pulled by your strings like a puppet.

4221.d: Of course not. Since we've made our deal the rebuilding program will be activated soon. You will become a part of it.

4225.d: Is there anything wrong? You weren't reacting to anything in the last minute.

4230.d: Valeera…don't waste too much time in mourning the past. What we should do now is to create a new future for the ones who are still alive.

4231.d: (I will not let this sacrifice be wasted...I'll save all of you.)

4232.d: We don't know if this is the last time sunlight will shine on the world.

4233.d: But under the cover of moonlight a new era has arrived.

4234.d: 14th Year of the New Calendar. Yume Academy has been in operation for 6 years.

4235.d: (Cough)…Just as I expected it's a mess up here.

4236.d: Ithil? Are you here for me?

4239.d: It's about time. The Academy is now fully functional so it won't be necessary for me to stay here.

4240.d: I don't agree with Li's methods for maintaining the Academy's operation…but I have to admit those measures needed to be taken.

4241.d: Still I feel sorry for them.

4243.d: Somewhere I can prepare myself for whatever danger the future holds.

4244.d: We know almost nothing outside the Academy. The war made me realize we have much to learn.

4245.d: I believe the world outside the Academy will have dangers we must know about and answers that we need.

4246.d: But… why should you be the one to go?

4247.d: Though Sivney has already left for the same reason I don't believe she will be as focused.

4248.d: The Observer and the students at the Academy are also not ready for this. It can only be me.

4249.d: I've done everything I need to. It's time for me to leave.

4251.d: I don't know. If I'm lucky it will be a few years… but if the world is bigger than I suspect it might take decades.

4254.d: Do you remember? We used to talk about what we would do once the war ended.

4255.d: I said I want to live in a library full of books.

4256.d: And I wished to travel… I never thought our dreams would come true in this way.

4257.d: I suspect I'm not going somewhere quiet and safe but somewhere noisy and dangerous.

4258.d: Before I forget I optimized the spell to dull your perception. Let me cast it on you one more time.

4259.d: Don't bother. My power will useful during my journey. I can handle its side-effects.

4260.d: Maybe when everything is over you can use the spell on me during my rest.

4263.d: I wish you the best of luck.

4265.d: 129th Year of the New Calendar. Yume Academy.

4266.d: I never thought this journey would take me a century.

4267.d: The Chaos has started to appear again. Something must have happened.

4268.d: The barricade that protects the Academy is also failing... Li must have reached his limit.

4269.d: At least the Academy is not in Chaos. Our Observer must be a vigilant one.

4270.d: Looks like I'm back right on time...

4272.d: The moonlight finally reappears after a century.

4273.d: Under the moonlight dim lights emerge.

4278.d: This is a shattered body. From its remaining form it seems to have once belonged to a female in her prime.

4279.d: It's hard to think that this body is still alive but its mouth continues to move.

4281.d: "It" lifted it's head gazing with its dead-eyes moved by the ray of light radianting from the sky.

4282.d: As if refusing to give up her last breath to destiny.

4284.d: Even after endlessly ravaged by Chaos?

4286.d: Then pray to the Gods my child.

4287.d: "It" lifts it's head gazing with it's dead-eyes moved by the ray of light coming from the sky.

4288.d: God… please save my life. I am willing to give out all what I have!

4290.d: God of Miracle and Wishes is here to answer your prayers.

4291.d: (Hehethe old man sure enough answered her prayers!)

4292.d: (Bet he wouldn't have thought that I've bonded with her. Her life is mine for the taking!)

4293.d: A Witnessed Miracle: You shall be granted with eternal life. A life of God.

4294.d: (Yes! Hehe…stupid old man grant me the power!)

4295.d: As for the price of a miracle

4296.d: you will lose all that you are now…

4300.d: The sun peeps through the entrance of the cave and is slowly swallowed by the depths. A young girl awakens.

4302.d: It seems the young girl has had a good night's rest. The crystal at the end of her tail turned a shade of warmth.

4303.d: She gazed towards the entrance of the cave.

4304.d: As the night had passed the entrance had attracted many chaos creatures as usual.

4306.d: With the flick of her finger and the sound of a crystal burst the chaos creatures dissolved into thin air.

4307.d: The young girl peeped outside the cave and observed her surroundings.

4308.d: A breezy sandstorm stirred with crystal fragments swept across the landscape. The ground is covered in crystals and diamonds.

4309.d: The landscape shimmers a dazzling white.

4310.d: Outlanders deem this place: The Dewy White Desert -- God's forsaken land of treasure.

4311.d: Of course the locals that had been here for generations might not regard the desert minerals as treasures or even wonder about its origins.

4312.d: Once the coast was clear she withdrew her gaze.

4313.d: But… she didn't seem to know where she should go.

4314.d: The endless wandering in this desert has made her forgotten where she came from and where she's heading.

4316.d: (Unconsciously she looked again at the crystal at the end of her tail)

4317.d: The light darting within the crystal created a reflection of herself on the surface of the crystal.

4319.d: My name is Krystal and I will continue to live through this day.

4320.d: Clusters of crystal fragments formed a part of the desert landscape.

4321.d: The sun energy gathered by the crystal had attracted many energy-hungry creatures such as the chaos creatures.

4322.d: This one seems good… Let me try and hunt some too…

4323.d: The energy must be plentiful. There are plenty of chaos creatures here. One of them is even about to evolve…

4325.d: The young girl sat barefoot on the edge of a crystal cluster her tail digging into the cracks wriggling and searching.

4327.d: Upon discovery of a rich source of energy Krystal's tail started swishing with excitement.

4328.d: Wah! Thank the Gods! I haven't indulged this much in awhile.

4329.d: I hope that some day I get to live well fed and well rested everyday!

4330.d: She closed her eyes as the energy source turned into an orb of glowing light and floated across from the crystal cluster into the crystal at the end of her tail.

4331.d: The light in the crystal cluster that once shined brilliantly instantly faded to a dull glow.

4332.d: Just before it lost its light the young girl opened her eyes ceasing absorption.

4334.d: But I need to get going unfortunately I can't stay here forever…

4335.d: The young girl gently patted the crystal cluster and continued on her way.

4337.d: As night fell she waved her hand and a cave made of hard crystal rose from the air. At the mouth of the cave she set a piece of high purity crystal in place.

4338.d: So the hungry chaos creatures can be distracted without noticing Krystal sleeping within.

4339.d: After preparations were made Krystal withdrew to the depths of the cave and falls asleep.

4342.d: Waahhh mama there's a huge crystal here.

4343.d: Hold on there's something else deep within.

4344.d: The young girl arose as the sun rose outside the window and slowly crept past the bed.

4348.d: Miss miss miss what's that on your tail!

4349.d: (Pats the young boy on the head)

4350.d: Ouch!... (hands on head and pouting at his mother)

4351.d: Excuse me he's lost his manners.

4352.d: Don't be afraid we mean no harm. This is our village.

4353.d: We found you last night sleeping out in the wild so we brought you back.

4355.d: That's right it's too dangerous outside.

4356.d: Little miss where is your family?

4357.d: How could they left you alone in such a place!.....

4360.d: In her short memory she did not recall any family.

4361.d: Realizing the young girl's expression the mother didn't know what to say…

4363.d: (Tugging and pointing at his mother) Mama is my family!

4365.d: (Tugging and looking into the mother's eyes) Mama is family?

4367.d: (With sudden excitement and hugging Krystal) Of course!

4368.d: (Poor girl must've lost her family at a young age……)

4369.d: Family… there's a sort of warmth to it…

4370.d: If you don't mind treat this as your own home and treat us as your family!

4372.d: Yes of course! You are my daughter and I am your mother!

4373.d: I… am your daughter and you… are my mother?

4374.d: Yes! (Holding Krystal and the young boy's hands) You are his sister and he is your brother. We are a family!

4375.d: (Holding the young boy's hand) I… am your sister and you are my little brother?

4376.d: Yay!! Brother recently left to a faraway place and now I have a sister to play with me!

4378.d: (Chuckles) No worries because… we're a family?

4379.d: (Hugging Krystal and the boy) That's right we're a family…

4380.d: Suddenly the mood was interrupted by sounds of people shouting.

4382.d: Quick! Move quickly! This is not a drill!

4383.d: Women and children find a place to hide. Men grab your weapons and follow me!

4385.d: Don't be afraid my children come with me let's find a place to hide.

4386.d: Upon hearing the noise Krystal got dressed immediately and opened the door.

4388.d: (Telling her brother) You and mama have to find a safe place to hide! I'll be right back!

4389.d: Before they could react Krystal ran outside.

4390.d: A crowd of villagers holding different weapons stood in attack position.

4391.d: Across from them were chaos creatures.

4392.d: Why is there a girl here?

4393.d: These are not ordinary beasts. It's too dangerous for you to be here! Find a place to hide!

4394.d: (Heading towards the creatures) Let us take care of them.

4395.d: (Cautiously watching the creatures while waving his hand to stop Krystal)

4396.d: The battle field is one of bloodshed I'm won't allow any women and children to die in vain before me!

4398.d: Then… I'll settle it right here.

4400.d: Is this… magic?! Only with a single spell…

4401.d: On one sunny afternoon the mother took her son and Krystal out for a stroll through the village.

4402.d: (Pointing ahead) Look! That's our weapons store right there.

4403.d: When there's usually danger in the village we'd look for the shopkeeper. You might have met him this morning.

4404.d: There's a lot of incredible weapons there!

4407.d: (Tiptoeing and pointing at a sword) I spotted this sword awhile ago isn't it cool!

4410.d: Uncle Big Beard said that when I'm of age he'll give the sword to me.

4411.d: I so badly want to defeat some monsters… Mama can't I be an adult already?

4412.d: No! You! Can't! You've just turned 10…

4414.d: (Appears suddenly) Well if it isn't our litte warrior. Have faith train hard and you'll soon be an adult!

4415.d: (Patting his own strong arms) But you need to train first until you're like me. You've still got a long way to go.

4416.d: Hmm… I'll continue to train hard!

4417.d: Could this be... the mage from this morning?

4418.d: (Witnessing this mage in battle this morning I knew I'm no match for her)

4419.d: Big Beard I'd like you to meet a new member of my family -- Krystal

4420.d: But first you're not allowed to influence her with your recklessness… (Gently strokes Krystal's hair) She's like a daughter to me now.

4422.d: (Gazes solemnly) Daughter!? Well then I've just got one thing to ask Miss Krystal.

4424.d: (Glasses almost falling) Big Beard didn't I just say no…

4425.d: Then please let us have an official challenge! We'll show the villagers your true strength!

4426.d: I… don't like to challenge humans.

4427.d: (Gaze growing distant) Sorry perhaps I was too rash.

4428.d: But please allow me to say this…

4429.d: (Gently looks at the young boy) In this world of chaos the peaceful lives of our village children rests on the bloodshed of us warriors.

4430.d: If those who can fight don't stand up no one else would…

4431.d: So please allow me to challenge you.

4432.d: If I win I wish to invite you to join our battle squad.

4433.d: (Glancing at mother and son then glancing at Big Beard) A peaceful life is built on the bloodshed of warriors?

4434.d: Krystal instantly recalls the chaos creatures that appeared in the village this morning.

4435.d: Recalling the countless dangers she had encountered on her journey alone she finally understood what Big Beard meant.

4436.d: Krystal… you don't have to force yourself if you don't want to.

4438.d: (Looks towards Big Beard) Please allow me to decline your invitation…

4439.d: It is the villagers that gave me this opportunity to live happily and so…

4440.d: Please give me the honor to challenge you Big Beard. If I win please allow me to join your battle squad!

4441.d: Haha! Of course! I accept your challenge.

4442.d: After a flash of white light Big Beard got up through a mist of dust.

4443.d: Hic… you're quite impressive. I haven't even gotten near and I've been overthrown by magic.

4444.d: But I have not relinquished my full strength… Let me fetch my ultimate weapon to challenge you.

4445.d: Be careful sis that's Big Beard most precious weapon. It's said to be able to cut crystal like butter! Ahhh Uncle Big Beard's a bully.

4446.d: (Adjusting stance gathering ultimate strength and taking a deep breath)

4447.d: Get ready Miss Krystal! With this ultimate sword I will not be conquered by ordinary magic again!

4450.d: (Big Beard charges at Krystal at full speed) Ultimate Slice Attack!

4451.d: With the cast of a finger a huge crystal rose into air!

4452.d: (The crystal's appeared! From this angle I can dodge it from the side!)

4453.d: Is that the only attack you've got?

4454.d: (As Big Beard was about to avoid it the crystal suddenly expanded and collided with him)

4457.d: (Rushing to Big Beard's side to examine the wound) Oh no I didn't know uncle was this feeble.

4458.d: Your word is more powerful than your magic…

4460.d: Big Beard's wound rapidly diminished and his pain faded away.

4461.d: (Oh it feels fine now… or rather I'm full of energy…)

4462.d: Miss Krystal could this be... magic too?

4463.d: Yes it's healing magic…My favorite magic…

4465.d: I'm alright. I've been fully convinced although it was embarassing.

4467.d: Oh my! She's defeated Big Beard! She must be powerful!...

4468.d: A small village in the middle of the desert. The sun rises outside the window and slowly creeps pass the bedside. A young girl awakes.

4469.d: My name... is Krystal and I want to continue to live through this day with the villagers.

4470.d: Today is a great day to farm.

4471.d: The mother brought her son and Krystal to their farm plot after chasing away Big beard who was waiting outside to see Krystal in the morning.

4472.d: In order to avoid the sandstorm and chaos creature invasion the crops were deeply buried beneath the soil relying on the sun energy collected by the surface crystals.

4473.d: For those unknown this place may look just like an ordinary dewy white desert landscape.

4474.d: As Krystal looked around she saw many villagers swinging their hoes.

4475.d: (Looking up at the sky) The weather's great today.

4476.d: (Holding a hoe) This area is our plot.

4477.d: The weather's really great today. Let's loosen the soil here.

4478.d: This way the crops buried deeply below can fully absorb the crystal's energy.

4479.d: (Patting the young boy on the head) But don't plough too hard like last time! You'll ruin the crops!

4483.d: Ooh wah! Watch out! Why are they hiding here!?

4485.d: The battle is over and the shattered crops laid scattered across the field.

4486.d: Before it could be restored more villagers located chaos creatures.

4487.d: Wah! What is this! It's caught my leg!

4490.d: How… how did these creatures get here!

4491.d: Uncle Big Beard you're finally here… it's so scary.

4492.d: Don't be scared everyone return to the village and take shelter!

4493.d: Krystal! This is your first mission with our squad! Let's go!

4495.d: Man… why does sis get to go on the battle field I also want to defeat monsters!

4497.d: The fierce battle had finally ended…

4498.d: Krystal dusted herself off and began healing the injured villagers.

4500.d: Ow… It's sore… But… it doesn't hurt anymore?

4501.d: That's the power of magic~ Ah I've put in too much…

4502.d: Awesome! I think I've gotten a little taller!!

4503.d: Haha uncle Big Beard my arms have gotten stronger too can I be an adult now?

4504.d: It's no use if you don't train your arms.

4505.d: The villagers celebrated as they survived through another attack.

4506.d: However the crops in the field are destroyed.

4507.d: The once consistent fields were now ravaged by battle. Broken vegetable leaves scattered across the ground.

4508.d: The villagers who were once pleased with their crops now fell into devastation.

4509.d: Oh God… you've taken my family and now destroyed my crops… How am I to continue living?

4510.d: My vegetables… you were all that I had left… How could you just…

4512.d: I'm really sorry that we were unable to protect the fields for everyone…

4513.d: What's the use of an apology… especially that little mage waving her magic everywhere and destroying our vegetables!

4516.d: My comrades we've damaged the fields but what we've protected are your lives!

4517.d: (Asserting voice) Some of your crops may have been damaged but it does not mean all hope is lost!

4518.d: At least not all the corps were destroyed…

4520.d: As long as a seed remains the power of the Gods will bestow it life.

4521.d: Roots produce stems developing into buds until its bears fruit.

4522.d: Krystal closed her eyes listening attentively to the cries of the villagers and the tremble of her crystal when a sudden thought occurred.

4523.d: Krystal walked barefoot to the center of the field.

4524.d: She felt the crystal and sand beneath her feet as well as the shattered vegetables.

4525.d: She felt life from the depths of the earth and felt their desire to grow…

4526.d: ….the Goddess of wishes and miracles once again heed your prayers.

4528.d: Her eyes opened as she casted both hands to the ground.

4529.d: A ray of sunlight reflected upon the crystal on her tail darting and flickering.

4530.d: If one looked close enough they would be surprised to find that the crystals across the fields were flickering to the beat her crystal tail.

4531.d: With every crystal and every flicker a glimmer of light slipped through the crystal and into the cracks of the earth.

4532.d: Somewhere deep down a dormant seed sprouted.

4533.d: Somewhere in the depths a root that was withering started to grow and grow until the visible eye could see it…

4534.d: Countless crops emerged from the depths of the earth one by one turning their leaves and bearing their fruits....

4535.d: In the blink of an eye the traces that were left by battle were completely concealed by crops that sprouted.

4536.d: The villagers stared in awe. Magic of life materializing before them and encircling Krystal awakening the seeds buried deep below....

4537.d: Green and golden crops now completely covered the barren land.

4539.d: Is this young girl really just a mage?

4540.d: This can only be described as a miracle…!

4541.d: According to ancient scripts this is the power of the Goddess of Miracles!

4542.d: Phew… (lightly grasping for breath) A strange person is approaching…? Hello?

4543.d: (Praying aloud) Allow me to worship at your feet! Oh benevolent Goddess of Miracles!

4544.d: (Blushing) No no you must be mistaken. I'm…

4545.d: Hmm? So you're a Goddess! Sis is the Goddess of Miracles!

4546.d: Oh! Allow me to also worship at your feet! Benevolent Goddess of Miracles!

4547.d: Allow us to worship at your feet! Benevolent Goddess of Miracles!

4548.d: (Looks up quietly) Our Goddess looks amazing…

4549.d: In the corner of the street sat a lonely girl dressed in gray.

4550.d: How wondrous our Goddess of Miracles… If I pray to her I wonder if my wishes will be come true?

4551.d: Ah she must has seen me…

4552.d: She's coming towards me! What should I do?

4553.d: Krystal caught sight of the feeble looking young girl pacing back and forth that once reminded her of herself.

4554.d: She reached out and waved her magic in that instant the young girl's complexion restored to it's health and shape.

4555.d: As Krystal walked along the road she found injured villagers from the previous battle and healed them one by one.

4556.d: The villagers were frightened by the increased appeareance of creatures but with the Goddess of Miracles amongst them they weren't frightened anymore.

5543.d: I feel that I'm doing something wrong but I can't put a finger on it.

5545.d: Go ahead. I'll be watching more attentively this time.

5548.d: The sword in Aquaris' hand glittered in the sunlight like the sparkling memories that Mika had in the past…

5550.d: Huh? Wait you're here in the training grounds instead of watching from aside this time.

5552.d: You keep on messing up at the same spot.

5553.d: Listen you need to pay attention to your side like this. If a sword pierces your side you won't have enough time to parry it.

5557.d: It's so tricky…what should I do?

5558.d: If you think this one's tricky I don't know what you'll do when you start practicing the hard ones.

5559.d: Mika sighed and accepted the sword Aquaris handed her.

5560.d: The sword that once belonged to her.

5561.d: Here I'll demonstrate it to you.

5562.d: Watch carefully because I'm not sure whether I will do this again.

5565.d: Mika looked exactly like the Swordmaster that saved her.

5566.d: I was too focused on the mistakes I made…

5567.d: One wrong step doesn't negate the other feats I have achieved nor the influence I had on others.

5568.d: I shall never forget the painful memories; they are a part of me now.

5569.d: However I will take up my sword again. It has given hope to so many others including this girl under my wing.

5570.d: The future is filled with endless possibilities

5571.d: and the heritage of the Master of the Swords will not be lost even if I no longer acknowledge myself with this title...

5572.d: "Flowers of all colors were in full bloom and as the wind blew through them it was like countless butterflies fluttered their wings in the grass fields..."

5573.d: Monica sits in front of a window reading quietly from a book. She imagines the scene as described from the words and smiles.

5574.d: Maybe I should decorate my room with flowers too.

5575.d: But...I don't know what types of flowers there are let alone how to take care of them. I should ask KongMing; she knows almost everything.

5576.d: Soon later a knock can be heard from KongMing's door.

5578.d: Monica? Come in. I didn't expect a visit from you.

5579.d: I was reading yesterday and the author made a beautiful metaphor regarding flowers.

5580.d: I want some flowers in my room too. I think they will...brighten up the room.

5581.d: Sounds good. I've always found comfort from the several potted plants I keep in my room.

5582.d: And that brings the topic back to my visit. Do you happen to know what types of plants or flowers don't require too much attention suitable for someone like me who has never taken care of plants before?

5583.d: I'm glad that you came to me but unfortunately I am no botany expert.

5584.d: ...No? But I thought...No it doesn't matter. Is there anyone else that I can consult regarding this matter?

5586.d: She belongs to the Gardening Club.

5587.d: ...I've never met her in person before. KongMing would you mind introducing us?

5588.d: Sure. Let's go then the Gardening Club is this way.

5590.d: The Garden of the Gardening Club is filled with all types of plants and flowers. There are signs of them being watered recently but no one could be seen.

5591.d: It seems like we've missed them.

5592.d: Perhaps but it's not hard to find Bud Elf. She fusses over her plants 24/7.

5593.d: She is probably tending to some flower bushes on campus right now.

5594.d: ...Oh. It's rare to find someone being this devoted to their cause these days.

5595.d: She values her plants over everything else and speaks to them. She wears her heart on her sleeve: she smiles when the flowers bloom and frowns when they wilt.

5596.d: Students not familiar with her believe that she is simple-minded naïve and deluded.

5597.d: This Bud Elf person sounds like quite the character.

5598.d: She is definitely a unique one.

5599.d: There she is among the bushes not far ahead.

5600.d: Bud Elf! ...Bud Elf can you hear me?

5601.d: Huh? Oh it's KongMing. Shh you're scaring my flowers.

5603.d: Monica is taken aback by their exchange. Bud Elf is just as how KongMing had described her.

5604.d: So is there a reason why you and Monica are here? I'm in the middle of something…

5605.d: Monica here would like to ask for your advice on household plants. Would you mind recommending some plants or flowers that don't require a lot of attention? She's new to this.

5606.d: Hmm that's a hard request. Every plant or flower requires care and attention. As long as you put enough effort into it then no flower is too hard to take care of.

5607.d: Whether you would like to exert this type of effort is up to you.

5608.d: Um...all I wanted to know is whether there is a type of flower that doesn't need too much attention. There must be at least one plant you know that fits the description...?

5610.d: Nope. It takes effort to cultivate plants no matter what type it is even the cactus. I have to talk to them and learn about their individual needs to make sure they grow healthy and strong.

5611.d: (She is more focused on the feelings of plants than actual people...)

5613.d: Monica seems dejected. KongMing bids Bud Elf goodbye then leaves Bud Elf to her own devices.

5614.d: I should probably do some research myself. Bud Elf...is just like you said. I don't understand why she values plants over people.

5615.d: Typical behavior of Bud Elf. She's very devoted to what she cares about and it's her plants.

5618.d: They're not completely identical but share that odd simple-mindedness.

5619.d: When I first arrived in the Academy Aquaris was responsible for setting up the stage. It was a sloppy job.

5620.d: A stage light wasn't secured properly and almost fell right onto Raphael.

5621.d: Ah I remember the performance. You were there to save the day weren't you?

5622.d: ...Yes. I know that she doesn't mean harm but she's just...not the brightest one on campus.

5623.d: I see why you made the connection now.

5624.d: Aquaris may seem simple-minded for the lack of a better word at first glance. However this doesn't stop her from being one of the most well-liked people on campus.

5625.d: Aside from the accident you mentioned she has helped out quite a lot. Without her we wouldn't be so...closely-knitted.

5626.d: Everyone has their place in a group: the charming and eloquent ones become leaders like Presidents of the six Houses.

5627.d: The kind and caring ones smooth out conflicts in the group.

5628.d: And the ones like Aquaris who are "simple-minded" who doesn't take many things to heart make the chemistry a lot less strained in the group.

5629.d: Being honest and not calculating are great qualities in all types of relationships.

5630.d: ...I never thought about this from this perspective.

5631.d: Take your time to think about it. With your countless years of watching people you should be able to understand in no time at all.

5632.d: ...What do you think about Bud Elf?

5633.d: Bud Elf? She is more creative and unique than the average student. She has her own special perspective of the world.

5634.d: A quality that is essential to the progress of human civilization I'd say.

5635.d: The words show wisdom beyond her years. Monica finds herself respecting KongMing even more.

5636.d: Monica's impression of Aquaris changed after her talk with KongMing but she still believes that it isn't good to be detached from the outer world like Bud Elf.

5637.d: After all effort and hard work are needed to ensure everything goes smoothly without trouble.

5638.d: Only those deep in touch with the world and its inhabitants can help it progress and grow.

5639.d: Monica is so immersed in her thoughts that she ignores the person calling her name.

5641.d: I've been trying to catch your attention for the past few minutes. Please don't tell me that you are ignoring me on purpose.

5643.d: Would you like to share with the class?

5644.d: I spoke with KongMing yesterday and she said something that stuck with me.

5645.d: She said that a person who has their own special perspective of the world is more creative and unique than others.

5646.d: Were you talking about Dr. Sivney? She's one of the most creative and special people that I've met.

5648.d: Bud Elf is rather creative too. I heard that she was working on this irrigation system for her plants...she can be seen as an inventor too I guess.

5649.d: Does Dr. Sivney think like Bud Elf too?

5650.d: Hmm to be honest I don't know. Why don't we ask Sivney in person?

5651.d: ...Wouldn't we be bothering her with our questions? It would be awkward if she kicked us out of her lab because of this...

5652.d: Aww don't worry she won't just throw us out like that. I know her.

5653.d: You know I didn't expect you to be this shy around people with all the years spent among them before you came here.

5654.d: We soon arrived at Sivney's Private Lab. I knocked on the door then let ourselves in.

5655.d: Who could it be...Senpai? Nice of you to visit me on this fine day. And you brought Monica with you too! Hello there.

5656.d: Nice to meet you Dr. Sivney.

5657.d: So what's the matter? You don't visit me unless you need a favor Senpai.

5658.d: Hey hey I just don't want to disturb you when you're working. If I had a choice I'd be making daily visits.

5659.d: Whatever that makes you feel at ease Senpai.

5660.d: Dr. Sivney your creations played a fundamental role in the establishment of Yume Academy and the level of technology shown in them even surpassed the greatest inventions in Human History.

5661.d: Well flattery never hurts anyone but I would appreciate it if you got to the point.

5662.d: ...I am curious about what was going on in your head when they were created.

5663.d: I met Bud Elf yesterday and learned that she sees the world through a flower-and-plant-shaped prism. Do you have your own particular prism that you see the world with too?

5664.d: I can't believe you are comparing me to Bud Elf. Besides prisms? Is this a philosophy thing that I should be aware of?

5665.d: I apologize if I insulted you in any way Dr. Sivney. I'd just like to know whether the thought processes of one of the brightest minds ever known in history differ from that of the regular being.

5666.d: Still laying on it a bit too thick but I get your point now. Unfortunately I've never given too much thought to it.

5667.d: It just seems like...like you are born into this role with all the effort-less brilliance and creativity like a Goddess.

5668.d: Wait I was similar to Bud Elf before and now I'm a Goddess?

5669.d: Well I can't deny that. Who knows I might even surpass the Gods one day with my creations.

5670.d: Have you ever heard the saying "Stay hungry stay foolish"?

5671.d: Words from a famous entrepreneur in human society?

5672.d: He quoted it from somewhere else but yes that's the phrase I'm talking about. Basically you have to keep on being unsatisfied with what you have and always aim for more. For me it's the hunger for knowledge.

5673.d: So this is what stirrs you on. Stay hungry...

5674.d: ...and stay foolish. This is a phrase that describes my condition.

5675.d: This curiosity...is instinctive to human beings. The effect of a certain type of hormone the name of which I can't really remember now makes you yearn for more.

5676.d: I believe there is an unhealthy level of those hormones in my bloodstream.

5677.d: In the end there are no "special thought processes" or "unusual mindsets" behind my creations. I follow my instincts and somehow things get done. End of story.

5679.d: ...I always thought that there were long complicated and intricated thought processes running in your brain turning out the amazing contraptions and making you special. That's what I was interested in.

5680.d: Like I said an unhealthy level of hormones messes with my brain.

5681.d: Perhaps I'm just a regular nobody without them like a puppet with its strings cut.

5682.d: I think you're trying to find something that doesn't exist.

5683.d: Bud Elf is a special kid but we're special in different ways.

5684.d: Monica is at a loss of what to say.

5685.d: She apparently doesn't approve of Sivney ascribing her success to hormones.

5686.d: After leaving Sivney's Lab Monica and I take a stroll under the Cherry Blossom trees on campus.

5687.d: The talk with Sivney doesn't clear the doubts in her head. If anything they exacerbate them. Despite having wandered the world for hundreds of years she is still uncertain about human nature.

5688.d: I remembered you saying that you like the smart and the wise when you first arrived here.

5689.d: Yes. I have a strong dislike for the asinine the simple-minded or the immature.

5690.d: You know when you think of it from another angle these traits might even be merits.

5691.d: Are you satisfied with Sivney's answers to your questions?

5692.d: ...I don't think so. I am surprised that she attributes her complexity and her brilliancy to hormones.

5693.d: If that's all there's to it then all we have to do is to inject the hormones to everyone and we'd have a bunch of genius scientists running around.

5694.d: It doesn't sit well with me. By the way Senpai...

5696.d: I ran into Dracula the other day. I used to believe that she was the girl that died on my watch.

5698.d: She said that I was delusional and that it was wishful thinking on my part.

5699.d: She sounded like Dr. Sivney now that I think about it. She said that she survived due to her instincts that her life wasn't any more complicated than anyone else and that she had no intentions for it to become any more complicated than it had to be in the foreseeable future.

5700.d: Sounds fake what with that ancient castle of hers but okay.

5701.d: I was convinced that I would be able to find what I was looking for from her such as the complexity of human nature.

5702.d: She had lived for a long time and had been through a lot. All these experience...is bound to change someone.

5703.d: But in the end it's back to "instincts" again isn't it?

5705.d: I was disappointed at that time. Now...I just find it ironic.

5706.d: Well the possibilities are endless and it's impossible to classify human beings as "complicated" or "simple".

5707.d: There is no "good personality trait" or "bad personality trait". There is only a "unique personality trait".

5708.d: I prided myself on having a deep understanding of human beings but I am still puzzled by individual humans.

5709.d: You're on the right path to solving the puzzle I believe.

5710.d: Maleficient violet mists drifted atop the small town neighboring Yume Academy. They're hard to ignore especially when looking down from a vantage point on top of a school building.

5711.d: Chaos is gathering again. This spells trouble.

5712.d: ...This meeting is called due to the Chaos Invasion of a neighboring town.

5713.d: Unfortunately we would need more intel on the situation before we can take any action.

5714.d: The townsfolk will suffer as preparations drag on...

5715.d: I understand your concerns Aquaris but you mustn't forget what happened the last time we moved rashly and many of our ranks were injured.

5716.d: Furthermore it appears that the Chaos invasion is not in the form of Chaos beasts this time. This calls for a different approach from what we used to do.

5717.d: Where did you get the information? I thought we didn't have any.

5718.d: KongMing glances at Vivian revealing her source of information. Of course Vivian the master of Fortune Telling.

5719.d: The alignment of the stars bodes evil...with the Chaos appearing this close to Campus I doubt it's a coincidence.

5720.d: Our enemies are not just Chaos Beasts this time. An army of robots has joined their force.

5721.d: An army of Chaos-corrupted robots and drones to be exact. The Chaos this time seems to hold the ability to possess inanimate objects.

5723.d: How did you get your hands on this information? Did the stars just tell you everything?

5724.d: Yes they do. I can glean meaning from the alignment of stars in the sky.

5725.d: I see. However from my perspective they are not stars just dots in the sky. How to interpret the shapes that the dots form is entirely up to the fortune teller isn't it?

5726.d: I'm saying that it's too dependent on the fortune teller and hardly a reliable source of information.

5727.d: Monica I understand that you are unfamiliar with the art of stargazing and therefore are cautious to trust its results. But I assure you there is a tried and trusted method to interpret the layout of the stars.

5728.d: Perhaps but I will stay wary of the "readings" you give when there are so many ways to interpret this.

5730.d: Monica has a point and I don't plan on basing our action plan on this one source of information. I will be sending trustworthy scouts to check out the area soon.

5731.d: Vivian pouts obviously not happy with Monica doubting the credibility of her readings.

5732.d: And what about you Monica? Do you think you are observing the truth when you reverse or speed up the flow of time watching the events fold out with your own eyes?

5733.d: At least closer to the truth than "messages from stars" I believe. I apologize if I offended you Vivian it's just that we work in different ways.

5734.d: Personally I find time-traveling to be a more stable way of gaining information.

5736.d: Erm stargazing isn't that bad. I mean Vivian once predicted that I will meet my sister here at Yume Academy and I'd like to believe that it's true.

5737.d: Have you heard about "Butterfly Effects" Monica? Even the smallest change in the past will cause unimaginable impacts on the future.

5738.d: The flow of time is in another dimension one that we cannot control.

5739.d: We are too weak and powerless when faced with greater entities than us such as the concept of time.

5740.d: All I try to do is to explain what the stars may want to show us not to manipulate the stars into shaping what we want to see. Unlike what you have been doing with time Monica if I have to add.

5742.d: No one dares to say a word. If a needle was dropped the sound will reverberate in the conference room for how silent it is. Monica and Vivian glare at each other.

5745.d: ...Awesome! Monica can you send me to the future to see what happens to me in the future?

5747.d: I mean I can't imagine whether I will get rich first or become a swordmaster first! Or I don't know become a very rich swordmaster!

5748.d: Or if you can't then I'll ask Vivian if she can ask the stars about this.

5749.d: What are you going on about? If you want fortune-telling services come to my tent after we solve this Chaos invasion issue.

5750.d: Back to Monica it is then! Please? Pretty please?

5751.d: Anyways the one who helps me is the better fortune teller or future reader or whatever it is!

5752.d: Aquaris if you haven't noticed we're having a serious discussion here. What brought about this anyway?

5753.d: They're getting nowhere with their arguments. I'm just providing a way to help!

5754.d: Of course nothing but good intentions from you. But I digress.

5755.d: It's established that this Chaos Invasion is different from the others we've witnessed in the past but we need more information about it.

5756.d: Do not lower your guard. After this meeting adjourns I will ask a few of us to scout out the area.

5757.d: The meeting will be reopened when they bring back intel about the situation. Any objections?

5760.d: The tension dissolves like water before Monica realized it and the arguments are gone without a trace.

5761.d: The realization hits Monica like a brick and gets her thinking deeply.

5762.d: Monica are you still worried about the Chaos Invasion? I think KongMing has everything covered as usual and nothing will go wrong.

5763.d: That is a part of my troubles yes but I am mainly concerned that I almost got into an argument with Vivian.

5764.d: Oh that. Yeah you are both smart and stubborn people. It's bound to happen sooner or later.

5765.d: I can't thank Aquaris enough for intervening before things escalated.

5767.d: Just as I said before Aquaris is very kind. There is this strange aura around her that just makes you feel at peace.

5768.d: What she said was inappropriate for a meeting but actually helped the meeting progress further.

5769.d: I seem to have misunderstood her greatly before.

5770.d: Don't worry she won't hold it against you. I'd also say that you just learned something new about human nature now.

5771.d: I did. Aquaris is far from being simple-minded. There is a hidden depth to her that I never discovered...

5772.d: The Chaos Invasion spread from one town to another and the purple mists take over more ground as the days pass by.

5773.d: Luckily KongMing's plan progresses steadily and Yume Academy now has a rough idea of what this unusual Chaos Invasion entails.

5774.d: To make sure the message spread fast enough KongMing wants someone to run the Radio Station.

5776.d: Are you worried that Aquaris will mess things up this time too Monica?

5777.d: It's hard not to after that fiasco with the stage lights. However if KongMing trusts her then I wouldn't object to her decision.

5778.d: Well I'll be there with her at the Radio Station too. I can keep an eye on her and make sure she gets the job done properly.

5779.d: If you need any help on that front you can come to me for help. I won't hesitate to lend a hand.

5780.d: I think Aquaris needs your help more than I do. She's probably still working on it now.

5781.d: She'd also appreciate your presence there.

5782.d: Very well. I have several questions for her myself.

5783.d: You? For Aquaris? This is unusual.

5784.d: Hiya Senpai! And Monica's here too!

5785.d: I haven't finished tidying up the place yet so it's a bit of a mess here. I hope you don't mind standing; all the chairs have mysteriously disappeared.

5786.d: It's alright. I'm just checking in to see how you're doing and whether you need any help.

5787.d: Not gonna lie you're doing surprisingly well so far.

5788.d: All thanks to you. By the way Monica how's your competition with Vivian?

5789.d: Wait there's a competition going on now?

5790.d: Hey I'm just really curious to hear what they have to say about my future.

5791.d: Monica giggles at Aquaris' antics. She is suddenly struck with a stray thought.

5792.d: Wait you honestly wanted us to tell your fortune on the meeting?

5794.d: Aquaris replies tilting her head in confusion.

5795.d: It's the fastest way to find out who's better. You'd never stop arguing otherwise.

5796.d: It's almost impossible to foretell the future without consequences.

5797.d: Just as Vivian said she can only try to glean meaning from the stars while I cause butterfly effects by traveling through time.

5799.d: Aquaris put her hand on her chin as she thinks.

5800.d: ...So are there better ways to peek into the future than stargazing and time-traveling?

5801.d: ...There might be. However they are beyond our abilities.

5803.d: …So neither of us should be judging the other right?

5804.d: Uh maybe? Why are you so serious all of a sudden?

5805.d: Aquaris seems disconcerted by the sudden change in Monica's mood.

5807.d: Great wisdom hides beneath a facade of stupidity...of course.

5809.d: That means you're the most intelligent person among us Aquaris.

5810.d: Hey stop making fun of me!

5811.d: Reports show that the traces of Chaos detected from the neighboring towns are all stored in discarded robots and drones.

5812.d: They were supposed to be inanimate but are now possessed by Chaos and attack everything on sight.

5813.d: Estimations are that this is a different type of Chaos that we're used to…

5814.d: Did you hear that? As the stars told me the Chaos this time is largely different from every case that we've dealt with in the past. That should be enough proof for the credibility of stargazing Monica.

5816.d: And I apologize for my behavior in the meeting. It was uncalled for and inappropriate for the situation back then.

5817.d: Um who are you and where is the real Monica? I surely didn't see that coming from you.

5818.d: Senpai called for a meeting again. We should probably get down to business.

5819.d: I believe it's time for action now.

5820.d: Senpai Monica Vivian Diana Aquaris and everyone in this room...I need your help in this battle.

5821.d: You don't have to ask KongMing. It's our duty to fight against the influence of Chaos!

5822.d: The Girls head out to the Chaos-infested towns

5824.d: What's worse the townsfolk are inflicted by an unknown plague one that takes away their sanity and causes them to go on a rampage…

5826.d: Under KongMing's lead the Girls managed to suppress the drones cleanse the Chaos influence from the town and return triumphantly to Yume Academy.

5827.d: Thank you all for your help and efforts ladies. Especially Monica who has finally proven herself in battle. I hope you will be joining us in operations like these more frequently in the future.

5828.d: I...will consider it. The Chaos that we encountered this time is definitely different from what I've seen in my travels before I came to the Academy.

5829.d: That's because they have resurrection abilities. They don't really die in the traditional sense: when we take down one drone the energies controlling it just disperses and comes together again to control something else.

5830.d: It's hard to take them down for good if you know what I mean.

5831.d: That's correct but not the only cause for those drones.

5833.d: It's a tragedy. There was a breakthrough in technology which made drone usage common in factories and the town thrived along with its industry.

5834.d: The thing about drones is that they never tire have no need for food and carry out their assignments with inhuman accuracy.

5835.d: Human workers couldn't keep up and many died from exhaustion. The despair of those workers never left the drones and attracted the Chaos here as well.

5836.d: Despair and Chaos merged together to form the...abominations that we fought.

5837.d: (...This sounds familiar...but where has I heard this before?)

5838.d: It was a recipe for disaster.

5839.d: On the outside everything seemed to be going well but this obviously didn't keep up. Soon the town deteriorated into what we see now.

5840.d: What a pity...this was a thriving town.

5841.d: There is...not much left of the townsfolk to rebuild the town. It might never return to its former glories or even reach a shadow of its former self.

5842.d: But that must be old news to you Monica. Even the most developed civilizations fall to ruins after reaching their peaks as you must have witnessed on your travels.

5844.d: Breakthrough in technology...drones...This is too familiar.

5846.d: Wow what a coincidence! Have you lived here before?

5847.d: Yes but it is not the bustling town that I remembered.

5849.d: Monica turns her gaze downwards with a pensive look on her face.

5850.d: ...It must be hard the reality not matching up with your memories.

5851.d: The streets used to be filled with people and decorations...now they are abandoned and bare. That is the way of life: everything comes to an end.

5853.d: Is there anything we can do to stop this from happening?

5854.d: Didn't you hear Monica? It's the way of life.

5855.d: It's the same with the moon: after the full moon darkness chips away at it until it disappears from the night sky.

5856.d: Erm that sounds...ominous. Does that mean we can only sit back and wait for our ends to come or something?

5857.d: That depends on what you do I'm afraid.

5858.d: Monica are you alright? You seem...distant.

5859.d: Monica makes a poor attempt at a smile. It looks more like a grimace.

5860.d: I'm just thinking that this is one of the few times Vivian and I agree with each other that everything ends.

5861.d: Her voice softens to barely a whisper.

5862.d: Are you worried that Yume Academy would end like this town too?

5863.d: What? The Academy? Please don't jinx us...

5865.d: The entrepreneurs I met back in the day were passionate and devoted to their work. Their successors...didn't inherit those traits.

5866.d: It is no surprise that they were unable to continue their families' work choosing to be spoiled by their wealth.

5867.d: Those who dwell in their contentment meet their end quickly...a lesson well-learned.

5870.d: Aquaris thinking? That's new. What's going on in your brilliant mind oh great philosopher of our times?

5871.d: Aquaris pays no attention to my jab.

5872.d: She mutters in a small voice.

5873.d: So from what we've gathered here: you can't be too content with what you have right?

5875.d: Following the same thought as long as we don't do that we won't be meeting our ends like the entrepreneurs in this town right?

5877.d: That...actually made sense. The future isn't written in stone and humans and the moon are largely different anyways.

5878.d: In the end it depends on the choices we make.

5879.d: That's right! There's no point being worried over what hasn't happened yet.

5880.d: It is us that determines what the future looks like and the Yume Academy is still young. It has endless possibilities.

5882.d: Monica giggles at the unexpectedness of everything: before arriving at the Academy she never would have imagined herself being surrounded by the camaraderie of the girls.

5883.d: It looks like Aquaris solved yet another puzzle of mine Senpai.

5884.d: Which one? The one about everything ending?

5885.d: Yes. Now that I think about it too much has happened since the War against Chaos. There are way too many things that we cannot control including our ends.

5886.d: As long as we do everything we can within our abilities...then it should be enough.

5887.d: Changed your mind on Aquaris now eh?

5888.d: I hate to admit it but yes you were right.

5889.d: Uh what did I say again?

5890.d: Oh you don't remember now? You said that human nature can't be summarized by "simple" or "complex"
